plates.title: Current design (2026)
plates.fact: Campeche's new 2026 plate keeps the state's 'Campeche puro amor' spirit, with CAMPECHE across the top and a decorative band along the bottom, and adds new anti-cloning security features.

notes: The state presented a new design for the 2026 re-plating (Gobierno de Campeche Facebook; Por Esto Jan 14, 2026). The final extension ran to Apr 30, 2026, with fines from May 1, 2026. The previous design (from 2023) was white with jaguars and the region's flora and fauna along the bottom and the slogan 'Campeche puro amor'. Official 2023 artwork exists at ucs.campeche.gob.mx/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/5F2F57D6-41AE-4800-9BEE-B3D332F262B8.jpeg ('Tramita tus placas en linea'; the page returned 502 here). Because it was replaced in 2026, it is not listed. I could not confirm the exact 2026 artwork details from an official page; seafi.campeche.gob.mx has no plate image. No specialty plates found.
